_: Starter flow spec. Copy to covers/<date>-<slug>/cover.json, edit, run ./build-covers.sh covers/<date>-<slug>. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
title: Plain statement of the topic
_cards: Two full-width cards is the default. span: 0.5 puts two side by side. Heights should sum to about 1000 with the gap.

cards.label: THE BROKEN WAY
cards.caption: One line, under the card. Not the punchline.
cards._nodes: x, y are fractions of the card's inner area. icon from icons-color.js, or value for a big number. tone: cyan green violet amber red indigo pink teal blue grey. badge: x | check. hero: true adds sparkles.
cards._edges: route: h (same row) | v (same column) | hvh (elbow, xm = fraction where the vertical run sits) | hv | vhv. n = numbered badge. fail: true = red head and label. side: above | below | left | right is a preference, not a rule.
cards._flow: edge indexes the packet walks, in order. Leave out anti-pattern edges you do not want animated.
cards._groups: dashed box around nodes, chip on its border: chip left | right | midleft | midright | bottom
cards._notes: free-placed chips for filling a dead corner

cards.label: THE FIX
cards.caption: Keep the payoff in the post.

_links: dashed connector between cards; toPill: true draws an elbow into the next pill
